thread:
incident-bot: Pager: Model-quality anomaly detected for rdx-2.0 in eu-west-1. Alert: HIGH. Symptoms: elevated hallucination rate on eval harness, p95 latency up ~220ms, affected ~12% of text-gen requests starting 03/15 18:11 UTC. Incident classification: P1.

Maya (oncall): ack — taking lead. @Leo can you pull the canary history and any recent quantization flags?

Leo: pulling logs now. Canary promoted at 18:04 UTC. I see an experimental attention kernel enabled (+att-v2) and quant-mode set to q4. Canary perf had small tail-ups but nothing flagged by auto-eval. Sending logs to #eng-runtime.

Priya (eng-ml): quick observation: eval harness used short-context unit tests only. Our long-context hallucination eval wasn't part of the gating for this promotion. That could explain undetected regression.

Maya (oncall): mitigation proposal: immediate traffic reroute for hosted and dedicated in eu-west-1 to rdx-1.9-compat until we confirm rdx-2.0 stability. Anyone object to emergency pin?

Carlos (cs): agree. Need a short customer-facing blurb ready before we start routing. I'll prep email and status page copy.

Maya (oncall): @deploy-bot execute: model.pin region=eu-west-1 group=hosted,dedicated target=rdx-1.9-compat reason="quality_regression_rdx-2.0"

deploy-bot: Received model.pin command. Performing safety checks (dry-run).

Leo: dry-run shows compatible signatures and no expected billing delta. Ok to proceed.

deploy-bot: Pin executed: hosted,dedicated -> rdx-1.9-compat in eu-west-1. Propagation started. Rollback window: 20m.

Maya (oncall): monitoring metrics now. Telemetry: p95 latency trending down, hallucination eval sample rate back to near-baseline after pin. Marking as mitigation applied.

incident-bot: Incident state updated: MITIGATED (routing fallback). Created ticket: INC-2026-2044. Investigator assignment pending.

Priya (eng-ml): investigation notes to capture: compare attention kernel att-v2 vs att-v1 behavior at long sequences; reproduce with q4 quant flags and 4k token prompts. Also check why the long-context eval wasn't run for canary.

Leo: adding runtime tasks: collect kernel selection traces, KV cache metrics, and memory fragmentation stats between 17:50-18:20 UTC. I'll attach artifacts to the incident.

Carlos (cs): status page draft (short):

```
Status: Degraded — Mitigation in place
Updated: 2026-03-15 18:35 UTC
Impact: A portion of text-generation requests in eu-west-1 experienced degraded output quality and increased latency due to a recent model promotion. We have routed impacted traffic to a stable variant (rdx-1.9-compat). No customer data was exposed or lost. We continue to monitor and will provide another update within 2 hours.
```

Carlos (cs): customer email template (editable):

```
Subject: Temporary model routing in eu-west-1 to maintain quality
Hi {{customer_name}},

We've detected an issue affecting the newly promoted rdx-2.0 model in eu-west-1 that caused occasional degraded responses. To protect your experience we have temporarily routed traffic to rdx-1.9-compat. You should see normal behavior immediately. We're investigating root cause and will share an update within 2 hours.

If you see anything unexpected, please reply and we'll escalate.

— Redwood Inference Support
```

Maya (oncall): Carlos — send to impacted accounts list, include INC-2026-2044. Keep replies linked to the ticket.

Priya (eng-ml): for the postmortem I'll run reproductions locally with: `--quant-mode q4 --attention-kernel att-v2 --max-tokens 4096` and the long-context prompt set LCTX-v2. If we can reproduce, we'll measure degradation threshold and push gating rule.

Leo: ops checklist completed: confirmed pin propagation, verified autoscaler for pinned pools, ensured billing unchanged, enumerated impacted client ids (attached in incident artifacts).

Maya (oncall): handoff plan for night oncall (night-maya assigned):
- Incident MITIGATED by pin at 18:14 UTC (rdx-1.9-compat).
- Monitor p95 latency and hallucination eval every 10m for eu-west-1.
- If deviations > baseline thresholds, escalate to @Priya and @Leo immediately.
- Do not unpin without explicit sign-off from Eng-ML + Oncall lead.

night-maya: ack — taking handoff. I'll post periodic updates and escalate if anything changes. :white_check_mark:

Maya (oncall): action items for postmortem and process improvements:
- Add long-context hallucination eval to canary gating for future model promotions.
- Add quant-mode and attention-kernel checks to the offline eval matrix.
- Consider automated rollback trigger if hallucination metric crosses X% in canary window.

Priya (eng-ml): noted. We'll prioritise a gating patch and aim for a rollback automation PR within 5 business days.

Carlos (cs): customer comms sent to impacted list. Logging replies under INC-2026-2044.

Maya (oncall): closing live mitigation loop. Thanks team. We'll include the timeline, artifacts, and recommended fixes in the postmortem.

incident-bot: Reminder: run the 'incident-retrospective' checklist and link the artifacts: /playbooks/postmortem-guidance."
